description: A national or local tax with its HONEST per-yen-traceability classification, emitted by the danjo revenue-ledger (ADR-2605301600). NON-adjudicating, factual registry record. `earmarkKind` ∈ {general, statutory-purpose, special-account} drives `perYen`: a tax is per-yen-traceable IFF earmarkKind = special-account (法定の特別会計繰入). `general` (一般会計, fungible) and `statutory-purpose` (目的税: 法定充当だが一般会計内, e.g. 消費税→社会保障) are both per-yen UNtraceable — the statutory direction is a disclosed FACT, never a claim that a specific yen was spent on it. `statutoryBasis` is mandatory (the law that fixes account/earmark). All figures `:representative` pending G7 live verification; aggregate-only (G10).

taxId.description: stable id, e.g. income-withholding / consumption / fixed-asset

ja.description: 日本語名称 (e.g. 源泉所得税)

earmarkKind.description: FACTUAL earmark structure. NOT a verdict. general=fungible; statutory-purpose=目的税 (legally directed, still fungible in the general account); special-account=特定財源 (per-yen traceable).

perYen.description: true IFF earmarkKind=special-account. Honest per-yen traceability flag.

specialAccount.description: the special account this tax flows to (only when earmarkKind=special-account)

statutoryPurpose.description: the legally-directed purpose (only when earmarkKind=statutory-purpose), e.g. social-security

collectedBy.description: org handle that collects this tax (→ com.etzhayyim.danjo.fiscalOrg)

statutoryBasis.description: the law fixing account/earmark (e.g. 消費税法1条2項, 復興財源確保法)

sourcing.description: MUST be representative — NOT an authoritative statement (G5 honesty).
